validation.method: 52-week standard: training-segment factor selection + correlation pruning + rolling-origin matured-label bucket calibration with causal terciles

oos_factor_inference.method: OOS Spearman IC; circular moving-block bootstrap percentile interval; circular-shift null diagnostic; Benjamini-Yekutieli FDR
oos_factor_inference.p_adjustment_method: Benjamini-Yekutieli FDR; conservative under arbitrary test dependence

sample_feasibility.estimate_assumptions: 52-week standard: fixed chronological selection segment, 60-session feature warm-up, H+1-session label spacing, labels matured by the decision bar, and the predeclared bucket count times 6 observations; score ties and missing factors can increase the requirement

sample_diagnostics.note: The non-overlapping count is the conservative figure and is never larger than the effective estimate; raw divided by horizon approximates dependence but is not a measured effective sample size.

multiple_testing.note: Adjusted p-values are disclosure only; selection still requires out-of-sample evidence.

warnings: Returns are gross close-to-close observations; this factor path does not model execution, spreads, slippage or fees.
Factor calibration uses only the 52-week daily-bar standard and never widens the window automatically to buy samples.
The rolling-origin evaluation has fewer than 10 matured-label factor predictions.
